content: Hello! This is HR. How can I assist you with your payroll or employee records today?
Hi, I just wanted to confirm that my salary deposit for June was processed. My name is Kevin Patel, employee ID KP7842.
Thank you, Kevin. I see the June payroll transfer for $2,950 was sent to your Bank of America account ending in 0934 on June 28th. The transaction reference is BOA-PYRL-20240628-1452.
Great, but I haven't seen it appear yet. Should I be worried?

No need for concern yet, Kevin. Sometimes transfers take up to 24 hours to appear, especially around month-end. Can you confirm the last four digits of your account are 0934 and that your registered email is k.patel@westhamtech.com?
Yes, that's correct, 0934 and the email matches. It's just urgent because I have a rent payment coming up tomorrow.

Understood about the urgency. Since your payroll was processed yesterday, it should reflect in your account by the end of today at the latest. If it doesn't, let us know immediately and we'll escalate with Bank of America using your reference BOA-PYRL-20240628-1452.
Thanks, I'll keep an eye on it. If there's any update, I'll reach out.
Absolutely. For any urgent financial matters, you can reach HR directly at 555-0129 or reply to this email chain. We'll prioritize your case if the deposit doesn't arrive today.
